lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#14 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Minnesota Vikings -4.3 with a fair total of 43.9 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts pass offence vs Minnesota Vikings pass defence, which sits −0.309 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Indianapolis Colts and Minnesota Vikings have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
